hero.description: Create clickable YouTube thumbnails in seconds. Write the cover hook, add an optional reference image, and preview three A/B-ready concepts.

inspiration.title: Start with a direction, not a blank canvas.
inspiration.description: A few thumbnail patterns that work well for creator content, tool reviews, challenges, and tutorial videos. The homepage stays focused; heavier inputs live in the workbench.

items.title: Three variants by default
items.description: Every run gives you three directions: curiosity, face focus, and bold text. It is made for quick A/B thinking.

items.title: Language-aware output
items.description: Pick the thumbnail text language separately from the interface. Useful when your channel targets another market.

items.title: Built for YouTube first
items.description: 16:9 is the main format. Shorts and social sizes stay available without making the home tool feel heavy.

meta.title: YouTube Thumbnail Maker
meta.description: A full ThumbAI workbench for YouTube thumbnail ideas, reference images, creator portraits, scripts, and A/B-ready mockups.

hero.title: Build the whole thumbnail brief in one place
hero.description: Bring a video idea, link, reference cover, creator face, video file, or script. ThumbAI turns the inputs into three clickable thumbnail directions you can compare before production.
hero.ideaPlaceholder: Example: I tested the cheapest AI desk setup for 30 days...
hero.assetsDescription: Add only what you have. More context helps the live AI pipeline produce stronger thumbnail directions.
hero.mockNotice: Signed-in runs use live AI; homepage previews stay lightweight

results.title: A/B-ready preview results

results.liveDescription: Live AI images generated through Replicate and saved to storage.

side.title: Why this page exists
items: The homepage stays fast and lightweight for first-time visitors.
Heavy inputs live here, so power users can build a stronger brief.
This route is ready for SEO, login limits, saved history, and Pro downloads.

assetActions.ready: Ready for the next AI step

mode.simpleTitle: Start with the inputs most creators actually use.
mode.simpleDescription: Use this for quick ideation: title, source link, output size, and language. It stays separate from the homepage because this page keeps the results, controls, and future history in one workspace.
mode.proTitle: For creators, strategists, and thumbnail designers.
mode.proDescription: Build a real thumbnail brief with strategy, composition, reference covers, creator portraits, video files, and scripts.

history.title: Generation history
history.description: Your latest saved generations. Click a card to inspect the brief, export again, or remove it from your account.
history.empty: No generation jobs yet. Add an idea and run your first thumbnail direction.
history.error: Generation failed on this run. Retry to send the job through the queue again.

authGate.signedOutTitle: Sign in to generate real thumbnails
authGate.signedOutDescription: The homepage stays free for quick previews. The workbench uses live AI, R2 storage, and generation history, so it needs an account before it can run.
authGate.signedInDescription: Your workbench runs through the protected live pipeline with rate limits and saved image storage.
